title: Session expiry check accepts a token during its expiry second
description: `Session::is_expired` treats the second a token expires in as still valid, so `validate` accepts the token for up to one second past its `expires_at`.
root_cause: `is_expired` compares with `now > self.expires_at` where `now >= self.expires_at` is meant.
intended_behavior: A token is refused from its `expires_at` second on.

trace.description: The handler reads the session token from the `Authorization` header and calls `Session::validate`.
The expiry comparison lets `now == expires_at` through.

evidence.description: The only expiry check is `now > self.expires_at`.

conditions.description: The request has to arrive within the token's last second.

execution.attacker_perspective: A client whose session token is about to expire.
payloads: a session token whose expires_at equals the test clock
instructions: Set the test clock to the token's expires_at.
execution.observed_result: In a local test run, validate returned Ok for the token at its expires_at second.

remediation.strategy: Compare with `>=`, so a token is refused from its `expires_at` second on.

likelihood.reason: The window is one second long.

impact.reason: The token was valid a second earlier, so no new access is gained.

confidence.reason: Reproduced in a local test run.

title: Session token compared with `==`
description: `Session::validate` compares the presented token with the stored one using `==` on byte slices, which can return at the first byte that differs.
claimed_root_cause: A secret is compared with a short-circuiting comparison instead of a constant-time one.

trace.description: The handler passes the `Authorization` header to `Session::from_header`.
The token is decoded and handed to `validate` unchanged.
The decoded token is compared with the stored token using `==`.

evidence.description: `if presented == self.token` decides whether the session is valid.
`token` is a plain `Vec<u8>` field, with no constant-time comparison type around it.

blockers: Whether the timing difference can be measured over the network needs the deployed service.

validation_plan.local: Time `validate` over many tokens that share a prefix of growing length with the stored token, and look for a trend.
validation_plan.deployment: Repeat the measurement against a test deployment from a host on the same network.

title: Login redirect target taken from the query string
description: `handle_login` reads the `next` query parameter and redirects to it after a successful login.
claimed_root_cause: An unchecked redirect target could send a user to another site after login.

trace.description: The handler reads the `next` query parameter.
The redirect response is built from the checked target.

evidence.description: `safe_redirect` keeps only relative paths that start with a single `/` and falls back to `/` otherwise.

reason: `safe_redirect` runs before the redirect is built and refuses any absolute or scheme-relative target, so the redirect cannot leave the site.
